summary.en: Separate where a name can be used from how long its object exists.
summary.bn: নাম কোথায় ব্যবহার করা যায় আর ভেরিয়েবল কতক্ষণ থাকে, এই দুই নিয়ম আলাদা করে বোঝো।

notes: C99 permits declarations within for headers; scope and storage duration remain separate concepts in C17.

sections.title: Visibility and existence answer different questions
Locate the declaration and its braces
Name lookup chooses the closest visible declaration
Observe names across blocks and calls
Four scopes and two common durations
Do not infer lifetime from indentation

examples.title: An inner mark hides an outer mark
examples.explanationHtml: The inner declaration introduces a different object. Leaving its block reveals the outer mark, still 70.

examples.title: Automatic reset and static persistence
examples.explanationHtml: Each visit prints 1 for automatic. The static counter prints 1, 2 and 3 because it survives the returns.

examples.title: Local and file-scope names
examples.explanationHtml: main hides the file-scope name locally. show_capacity has no such local declaration and therefore reads 40.

examples.title: A label can be used within its function
examples.explanationHtml: The label is visible throughout main. The jump does not carry a block-local object beyond its lifetime.

practice.title: Trace nested prices
practice.statementHtml: Read outer and inner prices from 0 to 1000. Use a nested block whose price hides the outer price. Print Two prices: first, then inner price and outer price on separate lines.
hints: Initialize the inner price from a differently named input.

practice.title: Repeat an automatic subtotal
practice.statementHtml: Read a repeat count from 0 to 10. Call a helper that creates local subtotal = 10 and adds 5. Print Repetitions: first, then 15 on its own line per call.
hints: The local subtotal starts again on every call.

practice.title: Persistent ticket numbers
practice.statementHtml: Read how many tickets to issue, from 1 to 10. A local static counter starts at 100 and increases before each return. Print Count: then each ticket number on a separate line.
hints: Give the static initializer a constant value.

practice.title: Separate function locals
practice.statementHtml: Read a value from 0 to 100. main retains it while another function doubles its own parameter with the same name. Print Input: then doubled and original values separated by a space.
hints: A shared spelling does not create shared storage.

quiz.prompt: What does a name's scope describe?
options: Where the declaration can be used
How many bytes its object occupies
quiz.explanation: Scope is a source-code visibility rule, separate from storage size or lifetime.

quiz.prompt: What happens to the outer object when an inner declaration shadows its name?
options: It still exists with its previous value
Its value is copied into the inner object automatically
quiz.explanation: Shadowing changes lookup. It does not itself alter or destroy the outer object.

quiz.prompt: A nested declaration hides mark temporarily. Which sequence is printed?
quiz.explanation: The nested object does not overwrite the outer six.

quiz.prompt: Which identifiers have function scope in C?
quiz.explanation: Labels can be named throughout their containing function. Ordinary locals use block scope.

quiz.prompt: What is the duration of a local static int?
options: Only the statement after its declaration
Until the next automatic variable is declared
quiz.explanation: Its name is local, but its object has static storage duration.

quiz.prompt: A static counter and an automatic counter are incremented twice. Which pairs appear?
quiz.explanation: fresh is initialized on every entry, while kept retains the first increment.

quiz.prompt: Can a file-scope name be used before its first visible declaration without another declaration?
options: No, file scope does not reach backward
Yes, every global name is visible from line one
quiz.explanation: Visibility starts at the applicable declaration point, even for file-scope names.

quiz.prompt: Where can a for-header counter declared with int be used?
quiz.explanation: The loop declaration covers its condition, update and body, but not statements after the loop.

quiz.prompt: A nested assignment has no new declaration. Which outer value is displayed?
quiz.explanation: Without a shadowing declaration, the assignment updates the existing total.

quiz.prompt: Why is returning an automatic local array address unsafe for later use?
options: The pointer result is always zero
C copies the array into static storage
The local array lifetime ends on return
quiz.explanation: The returned pointer does not extend the target object's lifetime.

quiz.prompt: Does a helper parameter named value share a caller's local object named value?
options: Only when the helper is defined after main
No, names in separate functions identify separate locals
quiz.explanation: Function-call nesting is not lexical scope nesting. Arguments provide values, not name-based connections.

keyPoints.en: Block scope ends at the matching closing brace.
keyPoints.bn: ব্লকের শেষ বন্ধনীতে সেই ব্লকের স্কোপ শেষ হয়।

keyPoints.en: A label has function scope, unlike ordinary local names.
keyPoints.bn: সাধারণ লোকাল নামের বিপরীতে লেবেলের স্কোপ পুরো ফাংশন।

keyPoints.en: File-scope names are visible from their declaration onward.
keyPoints.bn: ফাইল স্কোপের নাম ঘোষণার পর থেকে দেখা যায়।

keyPoints.en: Shadowing hides an outer name without destroying its object.
keyPoints.bn: শ্যাডোয়িং বাইরের নাম আড়াল করে, ভেরিয়েবল নষ্ট করে না।

keyPoints.en: Automatic objects belong to a particular block execution.
keyPoints.bn: অটোমেটিক ভেরিয়েবল ব্লকের নির্দিষ্টবার চালানোর সঙ্গে যুক্ত।

keyPoints.en: Static storage duration lasts for the entire program.
keyPoints.bn: স্ট্যাটিক স্টোরেজের ভেরিয়েবল পুরো প্রোগ্রাম চলাকাল থাকে।

examQuestions.question: Can a variable have block scope and still exist between calls? Explain with a static local counter.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Yes. Scope describes where its name is visible, while storage duration describes its existence. A local static counter has block scope and static storage duration. It is initialized once, retains its value after return and is reached again on later calls.

#include <stdio.h>



int main(void)
{
    int mark = 6;
    printf("%d ", mark);
    {
        int mark = 9;
        printf("%d ", mark);
    }
    printf("%d\n", mark);
    return 0;
}

6 9 6

The nested object does not overwrite the outer six.

examQuestions.question: Read a value from 0 to 100. main retains it while another function doubles its own parameter with the same name. Print Input: then doubled and original values separated by a space.
examQuestions.answerHtml:
#include <stdio.h>

int doubled(int value)
{
    value *= 2;
    return value;
}

int main(void)
{
    int value;
    puts("Input:");
    if (scanf("%d", &value) != 1 || value < 0 || value > 100) {
        return 1;
    }
    printf("%d %d\n", doubled(value), value);
    return 0;
}

A shared spelling does not create shared storage.

For input 0, the program prints:

Input:
0 0
